note: v0.17.0：分享功能 P1 —— 竖版卡片、进度报告卡、存进相册、朋友点开就是那一句。① 竖版 1080×1920（Story/抖音）；弹层内可切换 1:1 / 9:16，竖版不是拉伸而是重新分配留白（上下各一条回纹带，内容居中，页脚锚底）。② 新增「进度报告卡」：2×2 数据格（连续天数/已开口句数/点亮地标/徽章）+ 最近 14 天热力，全部取自真实状态；有积累（开口 ≥8 句或练过 ≥3 天）才会出现在主题池里。③ APK 原生壳「保存图片」改走系统相册：Android 10+ 经 MediaStore 写入 Pictures/Sinoky，不需要任何存储权限；低版本明确回退到长按保存（不申请多余权限）。④ 分享链接带上「是哪一句」：朋友点开直接落到同一句并高亮（复用场景入口自带的定位），同时给出说明提示；未完成引导页时会排队到引导结束后再打开。分享卡片依旧零第三方依赖、零新增请求，卡片上仍不含设备号/录音等任何个人信息。
noteEn: v0.17.0 Share cards (P1): portrait cards, a progress report card, save to gallery, and arriving on the exact line a friend shared. (1) 1080x1920 portrait (Story/TikTok) with an in-sheet 1:1 / 9:16 switch — the portrait layout redistributes whitespace rather than stretching, with meander bands top and bottom, content centred and the footer anchored to the bottom edge. (2) New progress report card: a 2x2 grid (days in a row / phrases said / landmarks lit / badges) plus a last-14-days heat strip, all from real state; it only enters the theme pool once there is something to report (8+ phrases said or 3+ days practised). (3) In the Android app the save action now writes to the system gallery via MediaStore on Android 10+, which needs no storage permission at all; older versions fall back to long-press save rather than asking for a permission the app does not need. (4) Share links now carry which line it was: opening one lands on that exact sentence with it highlighted, plus an explanatory note; if onboarding is not finished yet the jump is queued until it is. Cards remain dependency-free, add no network requests, and still carry no device ID or recording.
